blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.
blocks.zh: 本文研究了类别级RGB-D对象的推算,它恢复了对象的3D旋转和翻译,没有实例特定的CAD模型或参考视图. 由于班内差异、对称和部分观察,这项任务非常模糊。 目前的解决办法难以平衡可靠性和效率:基于中间结构的方法容易发生错误传播,而传播模型则有很高的推论延迟和复杂的热后候选人提取。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了F2G-Pose,即一个实时的直线,单通道框架,从一个向导的通道中,从单一的RGB-D观测中预测出类别级的姿势,度量大小,以及完成的相机帧形状. F2G-Pose将稠密的视觉基础特征提升至部分点云,用DGCNN的标志化编码局部几何,并整合了带有Mixture-of-Experts Transformer的物体级结构. 联合大小预测和照相机框架形状的完成,通过密集的几何监督,鼓励了计量的一致性。 F2G-Pose在任务特异性网络中只接受姿势附加的合成SOPE数据培训,其冷冻的RADIO主干线在外部经过预先训练后,在SOPE和ROPE上实现了最先进的精度,同时运行在28 FPS上,仅作姿势推断,并进一步展示了HouseCat6D上和HANDAL上的实际对象转移上的强相机框架几何. 对耐久性,稳健性,形状完成性,以及GenPose++候选行为的分析进一步证明了F2G-Pose的效率和可靠性,现实世界的操纵实验在分块的RGB-D输入下证明了部署潜力. 项目网页、代码和预先培训过的模型可在https://jryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Category-level 6D object pose estimation recovers an object’s 3D rotation and translation without requiring an instance-specific CAD model or reference views at test time. In practical RGB-D perception, this estimate is often coupled with metric size and usable object geometry for benchmark evaluation [ 42 , 50 , 9 ] , physical interaction [ 37 , 38 , 6 ] , and robotic control [ 45 , 23 , 44 , 15 , 14 , 25 ] . This setting is inherently challenging because partial observations from a single crop or segmented point cloud provide incomplete evidence: symmetries induce rotational ambiguity, occlusions hide discriminative geometry, and intra-class variations alter shape, size, and appearance. Consequently, category-level perception must produce reliable metric predictions from ambiguous, incomplete, and noisy observations.
blocks.zh: 类别级6D对象提出估计,可以恢复对象的3D旋转和翻译,而不需要在测试时需要特定实例的CAD模型或参考视图. 在实际的RGB-D感知中,这种估计往往会结合度量大小和可用对象几何来进行基准评价[42,50,9],物理相互作用[37,38,6],以及机器人控制[45,23,44,15,14,25]. 这种设定本身具有挑战性,因为单一作物或分点云的部分观测提供了不完整的证据:对称会诱发自转的模糊性,隐蔽会隐藏有区别的几何,而类内的变化会改变形状、大小和外观。 因此,类别层面的认知必须从模棱两可、不完整和吵闹的观察中得出可靠的衡量预测。

blocks.en: Previous work has addressed this problem from two complementary directions. Deterministic category-level methods estimate pose and size through canonical coordinates [ 42 ] , correspondences [ 2 ] , shape priors [ 16 ] , deformation models [ 39 ] , alignment procedures [ 24 ] , or direct regression [ 26 , 43 , 17 ] . While these methods enable efficient inference, reliance on intermediate structures can lead to compounding errors. Under occlusion, missing depth, intra-class variation, and domain shift, the final metric estimate can become sensitive to the reliability of these intermediate structures. Direct regression can avoid some post-hoc alignment steps, but reliable direct prediction still requires representations that preserve local geometric cues and global object structure under partial observations.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作从两个相辅相成的方向解决这一问题。 定型类分级方法通过舟子座标[42],函式[2],形状前缀[16],变形模型[39],对接程序[24],或直接回归[26,43,17]来估计所呈现的姿势和大小. 虽然这些方法能够有效推导,但依赖中间结构可能导致复合出错. 在被封存,缺少深度,类内变异,和域相移下,最终的度量估计可以对这些中间结构的可靠性变得敏感. 直接回归可以避免一些后热调和步骤,但可靠的直接预测仍然需要在局部观测下保留局部几何提示和全球物体结构的表示.

blocks.en:
A complementary line of work models pose ambiguity explicitly. GenPose [ 51 ] and GenPose++ [ 50 ] formulate category-level pose estimation as conditional pose distribution modeling, sampling multiple hypotheses and converting them into a prediction through scoring, filtering, clustering, or aggregation. This is principled for uncertainty representation, but it introduces a candidate-to-decision gap: deployed accuracy depends not only on the sampled hypotheses, but also on whether post-hoc extraction can select or aggregate a reliable representative. Moreover, this conversion must operate under a practical inference budget as in Fig. 3 , so sampling quality, candidate extraction, and computational cost become coupled. Joint-RegDiff [ 20 ] and RFMPose [ 32 ] improve generative pose inference through joint regression–diffusion learning with score-scaling sampling and Riemannian flow-matching trajectories, respectively, but both still rely on iterative generative inference to produce the prediction, so prediction quality remains coupled with
sampling dynamics, candidate extraction, and inference cost.

补充性的工作模式显然造成模糊不清。 GenPose [51]和GenPose++ [50] 将类别级形成有条件的姿势分布模型,取样多种假说,并通过打分,过滤,集群,或聚合将其转化为预测. 这对不确定性的代表性是原则性的,但它引入了一个候选人对决定的差距:部署的准确性不仅取决于抽样假设,还取决于采掘后是否能够选择或汇总一个可靠的代表. 此外,这种转换必须像图3那样在实际推算预算下进行,这样取样质量、候选人提取和计算费用就会相加。 联合-RegDiff [20]和RFMPose [32]通过联合回归-分解学习,分别通过分数分级抽样和里曼流相匹配的轨迹改进了基因相位推论,但两者仍然依赖迭代基因相接推论来产生预测,因此预测质量仍然伴随着

blocks.en: We introduce F2G-Pose, a direct RGB-D framework that jointly estimates category-level pose, size, and camera-frame completed geometry in a single feed-forward pass. By leveraging geometry-aware foundation feature lifting and dense geometric supervision, it bypasses intermediate canonical shape alignment and avoids the sampling and candidate extraction used by sampling-based pose estimators. Specifically, we lift dense visual foundation features [ 13 ] to the partial point cloud for semantic cues, encode local geometry via DGCNN tokenization, and integrate object-level structure using a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer that provides conditional capacity across diverse shape regimes. Then, the pose-size head predicts the final metric estimate, while the shape head reconstructs camera-frame geometry as both auxiliary supervision and a usable output. This joint design encourages the shared representation to encode visible local evidence, object extent, and visible-to-complete geometric structure for consistent direct prediction under partial observations.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了F2G-Pose,一个直接的RGB-D框架,这个框架共同估计了类别级的姿势,大小,相机-帧在一个向后传的单一回馈中完成的几何. 通过利用几何-认识地基地物起重和密集的几何监督,它绕过中间地克外形对接,并避免了以取样为基础的姿势估计器所使用的采样和候选取出. 具体地说,我们把密集的视觉地基特征[13]提升到部分点云中,用于语义提示,通过DGCNN符号化来编码局部几何,并使用能提供不同形状体系的有条件能力的Mixture-of-Experts变形器来整合对象级结构. 然后,姿势尺寸头会预测最终的度量估计,而外形头则会重建相机-帧几何,既是辅助监督,又是可使用的输出. 这种联合设计鼓励共享的表示来编码可见的局部证据,对象范围,和可见到完整的几何结构,以便在部分观测下进行一致的直接预测.

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of this design, we train the task-specific network only on pose-annotated synthetic data from 149 SOPE categories [ 50 ] and test on SOPE [ 50 ] , ROPE [ 50 ] , HANDAL [ 10 ] , and HouseCat6D [ 17 ] . These benchmarks cover synthetic benchmark accuracy, synthetic-to-real transfer, additional real-object evaluation, and camera-frame shape reconstruction. F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while running at 28 FPS for pose inference. Beyond benchmark accuracy, we evaluate latency, robustness to perturbations and occlusion, shape reconstruction, GenPose++ candidate behavior, and real-world robotic manipulation. These results demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of direct feed-forward prediction, while robotic experiments demonstrate deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这一设计的有效性,我们只根据149个SOPE类别[50]和测试SOPE[50]、ROPE[50]、HANDAL[10]和HouseCat6D[17]的附加说明的合成数据来培训具体任务网络。 这些基准包括合成基准的准确性、合成到实际转移、额外的实际物体评价以及相机阵形重建。 F2G-Pose在运行于28个FPS进行姿势推论时,实现了最先进的精度. 除了基准准确性外,我们评价耐久性、强健性与扰动性和隐蔽性、造型重建、GenPose++候选行为以及现实世界机器人操纵。 这些结果表明直接向导预测的效率和可靠性,而机器人实验则显示在分块的RGB-D投入下部署的潜力.

blocks.en: Contributions. Our contributions are threefold: (1) We present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct RGB-D framework that predicts category-level 6D pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape in a single feed-forward pass, sharing its representation across pose, size, and shape learning. (2) We introduce geometry-aware foundation feature lifting to map dense visual features onto partial point clouds. DGCNN encodes local geometry, a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer integrates object-level structure, and camera-frame shape completion provides dense geometric supervision for metric prediction. (3) Extensive evaluations across synthetic benchmarks and real-world datasets demonstrate that F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, real-time inference, and high-quality shape completion. Furthermore, physical manipulation experiments demonstrate pick-and-place success, timely decision readiness, and deployment feasibility under segmented RGB-D inputs.

DGCNN 编码了局部几何,一种相机-Of-Experts变形器整合了对象级结构,相机-帧形状的完成为测量预测提供了密集的几何监督. (3)对合成基准和现实世界数据集的广泛评价表明,F2G-Pose实现了最先进的准确性,实时推论,高质量的外形完成. 此外,物理操纵试验表明,在分块的RGB-D投入下,选取和选取成功、及时做好决策准备以及部署可行性。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Category-Level 6D Pose Estimation. Category-level methods aim to generalize pose estimation across unseen object instances within a category [ 42 , 43 , 17 ] . Early works such as NOCS [ 42 ] introduced the notion of canonical space to enable pose alignment without requiring CAD models. Follow-up approaches [ 24 , 26 , 2 , 51 ] leveraged point cloud geometry and symmetry-aware losses to improve generalization. Some methods further incorporate shape-aware modeling [ 39 , 16 ] to jointly predict object size and shape.
While these methods remove the need for object-specific models, many rely on intermediate canonical coordinates, correspondences, deformation fields, or shape priors whose reliability can degrade under occlusion, missing depth, and strong intra-category variation. Recent works have attempted to scale category-level 6D learning using larger and more diverse datasets [ 53 , 18 ] , making representation quality and inference efficiency increasingly important.
Diffusion-based methods such as GenPose [ 51 ] and GenPose++ [ 50 ] model pose and size as multi-modal distributions, but often rely on auxiliary scoring networks to filter outlier samples.
Joint-RegDiff [ 20 ] eliminates the need for such scoring networks through time-dependent score scaling, and RFMPose [ 32 ] formulates generative category-level pose estimation with Riemannian flow matching; however, both remain limited to 6D pose estimation and still require iterative generative inference, which generally increases inference cost and can limit real-time throughput.

blocks.en:
Instance-Level Novel Object Pose Estimation. Another line of work estimates pose for novel object instances using CAD models [ 19 , 29 ] , single-view references, or multi-view references [ 21 , 27 , 11 ] . They often reconstruct object geometry, either explicitly via 3D modeling [ 28 , 22 ] or implicitly through image-based retrieval [ 12 , 30 ] . FoundationPose [ 46 ] supports either CAD or reference images, combining model-based and model-free paradigms.
Recent foundation reconstruction models such as SAM 3D [ 35 ] reconstruct object geometry, texture, and layout from masked single images, targeting image-to-3D asset reconstruction in natural scenes.
Together, these methods broaden object-centric 3D perception, but generally target instance-specific reconstruction or reference-conditioned alignment rather than category-level pose-size estimation under a fixed taxonomy.
F2G-Pose targets this complementary category-level setting: it uses category-level canonical supervision during training, but requires only a segmented RGB-D observation at inference time for the evaluated taxonomy.

blocks.en: 3.1 Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting
blocks.zh: 3.1 几何-智能基金会

F2G-Pose uses RADIOv2.5 [ 13 ] to provide dense visual evidence for the partial RGB-D observation. RADIOv2.5 distills complementary 2D vision models [ 34 , 31 , 33 , 7 ] , combining dense feature extraction from SAM [ 34 ] with semantic features from DINOv2 [ 31 ] . Prior work has shown that DINOv2-style local features can support pose-consistent correspondences across object appearance and shape variation [ 52 , 54 ] . We use these features not as a standalone image prior, but as point-wise appearance and semantic cues attached to metric 3D observations.
Given an RGB crop 𝐈 \mathbf{I} , we fuse RADIOv2.5 layers l ∈ { 8 , 16 , 23 } l\in\{8,16,23\} as 𝐅 rgb = ℛ ⁡ ( ∑ l α l ​ 𝒞 l ​ ( 𝐄 RADIO ​ ( 𝐈 ) l ) ) ∈ ℝ h × w × 1024 \mathbf{F}_{\text{rgb}}=\mathcal{R}\big(\sum_{l}\alpha_{l}\mathcal{C}_{l}(\mathbf{E}_{\text{RADIO}}(\mathbf{I})_{l})\big)\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times 1024} . blocks.en: 3.2 MoE-Based Object Encoding
blocks.zh: 3.2 基于 MoE 对象编码

blocks.en: The DGCNN tokens encode local surface neighborhoods and point-wise visual cues. We process these tokens with a stack of Transformer blocks with multi-head self-attention [ 40 ] , following the use of Transformers for point cloud completion and geometry modeling [ 48 , 49 ] . This stage integrates local evidence across the object crop to form an object-level representation for metric prediction.
blocks.zh: DGCNN地标编码了本地地表相邻的地标和指向的视觉提示. 我们在使用变形器来完成点云和几何模型[48,49]之后,用一叠带有多头自意的变形器块来处理这些符号. 这一阶段综合了整个物体作物的局部证据,形成用于度量预测的物体级代表.

blocks.en: To increase representation capacity with conditional expert aggregation, we replace the standard feed-forward layers in each Transformer block with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers [ 5 , 8 , 4 ] . Each MoE layer contains an independent set of experts and uses a linear gating network to compute softmax probabilities over N e = 8 N_{e}=8 experts. For each token, we select the top-2 experts according to the gating scores, route the token to these experts, and aggregate their outputs using the selected probabilities renormalized to sum to one. A soft load-balancing penalty encourages balanced gate probabilities during training [ 36 ] . Finally, the encoded tokens are aggregated by global pooling to produce a compact object representation for direct 6D pose, size, and shape prediction.
blocks.zh: 为了以有条件的专家汇总来增加代表能力,我们将每个变形器区块中的标准向导层取而代之的是专家混合层[5,8,4]. 每个MOE层包含一组独立的专家,并使用一线性齿轮网络来计算N e = 8 N_{e}=8位专家的软磁概率. 对于每个符号,我们根据标出分数选择前2位专家,将符号路由给这些专家,并使用选定的概率复常来汇总其输出,相加为一. 软负载平衡处罚鼓励训练期间平衡出门概率[36]. 最后,编码的代号通过全球集合加以汇总,为直接的6D外观、尺寸和形状预测制作一个紧凑的物体表示。

blocks.en: 3.3 Direct Pose-Size and Shape Decoding
blocks.zh: 3.3 直接松鼠和形状解码

blocks.en: F2G-Pose uses two lightweight decoding branches on top of the shared object representation. The pose-size branch predicts the metric state directly, while the shape branch predicts complete geometry in the camera frame. Both branches are trained jointly, so dense geometric supervision can regularize the representation used for direct pose and size prediction without adding any test-time optimization or candidate extraction.
blocks.zh: F2G-Pose在共享对象代表上方使用两个轻量级解码分支. 姿势大小的分支直接预测了公尺状态,而形状分支则预测了相机框中完整的几何. 两个分支都是联合训练的,因此密集的几何监督可以规范用于直接姿势和大小预测的表示,而无需添加任何测试时间优化或候选取出.

blocks.en: Pose and Size Estimation. The pose-size branch regresses rotation, translation, and metric size directly from the global object representation. For rotation, we adopt the continuous 6D representation [ 56 ] , which uses the first two columns of the rotation matrix 𝐑 ∈ SO ​ ( 3 ) \mathbf{R}\in\text{SO}(3) and reconstructs a valid matrix via orthogonalization. This parameterization improves optimization stability while keeping the prediction deterministic and feed-forward. The branch outputs the final pose-size estimate directly, without sampling pose candidates or applying post-hoc aggregation.
blocks.zh: Pose和大小估计. 平面大小分支会直接从全局对象表示回落到旋转,翻译和度量大小. 对于旋转,我们采用连续的6D表示 [56],它使用旋转矩阵R QQ SO (3)\mathbf{R}\in\text{SO}(3)的前两列,并通过正向化重建一个有效的矩阵. 这种参数化提高了优化稳定性,同时保持了预测的确定性和向导性. 该处直接提供最后的姿势大小估计数,不进行取样,也不进行事后汇总。

blocks.en: Camera-Frame Shape Completion. From the extracted global feature vector, we first regress a coarse complete object shape 𝐏 coarse ∈ ℝ 512 × 3 \mathbf{P}_{\text{coarse}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 3} using a lightweight MLP. Since the input partial point cloud 𝐏 \mathbf{P} contains observed metric geometry, we concatenate 𝐏 coarse \mathbf{P}_{\text{coarse}} with farthest-point-sampled observations from 𝐏 \mathbf{P} to form a combined point set, which is then processed through another MLP with a Sigmoid activation to produce a confidence score for each point. This selects reliable points for fusion, producing the refined fused point cloud 𝐏 fuse ∈ ℝ 512 × 3 \mathbf{P}_{\text{fuse}}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 3} . Finally, each point in 𝐏 fuse \mathbf{P}_{\text{fuse}} is augmented with the global feature vector and passed through an MLP to predict four local offsets per point, yielding 𝐏 dense ∈ ℝ 2048 × 3 \mathbf{P}_{\text{dense}}\in\mathbb{R}^{2048\times 3} . The shape is reconstructed directly in the camera frame, providing a geometry output and a dense auxiliary signal for learning metric-consistent object representations.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
Datasets. We use SOPE [ 50 ] as the training source for F2G-Pose; it contains 5K synthetic object instances from 149 categories with category-level canonical pose, metric size, and complete shape supervision.
Pose-size evaluation uses SOPE and ROPE [ 50 ] : SOPE measures synthetic benchmark performance, while ROPE evaluates transfer to scanned real objects under the same category taxonomy.
For camera-frame geometry evaluation, we use SOPE and HouseCat6D [ 17 ] , where complete object geometry is available.
For additional real-world transfer, we evaluate selected HANDAL objects [ 10 ] , including hammers, mugs, pans, and wrench-like tools. The 92 instances from seven HANDAL categories map to six SOPE categories; selection follows taxonomy correspondence. Thus, ROPE and this HANDAL subset evaluate seen-category, unseen-instance transfer (Appendix B.4 ).
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们使用 SOPE [50] 作为F2G-Pose 的训练源;它包含来自149个类的5K个合成物体实例,具有类别级的犬形姿势,度量大小,以及完整的形状监督.
Pose-大小评价使用SOPE和ROPE[50]: SOPE测量合成基准性能,而ROPE则在同一类分类法下评价向被扫描出的真实物体的转移.
对于相机-帧几何评价,我们使用SOPE和HouseCat6D[17],其中有完整的对象几何.
对于额外的现实世界转移,我们评价了选定的HANDAL对象[10],包括锤子,杯子,锅,和类似扳手的工具. 从七个HANDAL类到六个SOPE类的92个实例;选择遵循分类学对应. 因此,ROPE和这个HANDAL子集评价了目视类,隐形转移(附录B.4.).

blocks.en:
Baselines and metrics. For category-level pose-size estimation, we compare with NOCS, SGPA, IST-Net, HS-Pose, GenPose, and GenPose++ using the SOPE/ROPE benchmark results reported by Omni6DPose [ 50 ] .
Joint-RegDiff [ 20 ] and RFMPose [ 32 ] are report-only comparisons from their papers, using public metrics available under the SOPE/ROPE taxonomy.
For reference-based comparisons on real datasets, we additionally report FoundationPose [ 46 ] and Any6D [ 21 ] .
For runtime comparison, we benchmark executable methods under a unified inference protocol using the same segmentation masks, RGB-D crops, depth preprocessing, batch size 1, and GPU-synchronized timing on one RTX 4090; accuracy results follow the evaluation sources specified above.
Pose-size accuracy is evaluated with AUC of 3D bounding-box IoU at thresholds 25/50/75, VUS under joint rotation-translation thresholds, and mean rotation/translation error.
Shape completion is evaluated using Chamfer-L1 distance.
blocks.zh:
基线和衡量标准。 关于类别级姿势大小估计,我们使用Omni6DPose报告的基准结果与NOCS、SGPA、IST-Net、HS-Pose、GenPose和GenPose++进行比较。
联合-RegDiff [20]和RFMPose [32]是仅从论文中进行的报告比较,使用SOPE/ROPE分类法下现有的公共指标。
关于真实数据集的参考比较,我们另外报告FoundationPose[46]和Any6D[21]。
为了进行运行时间比较,我们使用相同的分解口罩,RGB-D收成,深度预处理,批量尺寸1,以及一台RTX 4090上的GPU同步计时,在统一推算协议下基准可执行方法;准确性结果遵循上述评价来源.

Pose-size accuracy and latency. Table 1 shows that F2G-Pose improves the accuracy-latency operating point of category-level RGB-D pose estimation.
On SOPE, F2G-Pose improves GenPose++ from 31.9 to 43.7 AUC at IoU50 and reduces mean rotation error from 19.9 ∘ 19.9^{\circ} to 15.7 ∘ 15.7^{\circ} ; on ROPE, it improves AUC across all IoU thresholds and matches or exceeds the available high-precision VUS results.
This gain is not only a speedup from removing iterative sampling.
The larger improvement on IoU and rotation-sensitive metrics indicates that direct prediction benefits from stronger conditioning: dense image features preserve category and part cues, local point neighborhoods preserve observed surface evidence, and global token interactions integrate these cues into a metric pose-size estimate.
At the same time, F2G-Pose runs at 28 FPS in pose-only mode and 24 FPS in full-model mode, compared with 4 FPS for GenPose++, yielding a single-pass estimate without candidate scoring, filtering, or clustering. More qualitative examples are provided in Appendix A.7 .

这种增益不仅是去除迭代采样的速度.
对IoU和旋转敏感度测量值的较大改进表明,更强的调节值可带来直接的预测效益:密集的图像特征保留了分类和部分提示,局部点附近保存了所观测到的表面证据,全球符号相互作用将这些提示整合到一个度量平面大小估计中.
同时,F2G-Pose以28个FPS只以姿势模式运行,24个FPS以全模模式运行,而GenPose+则以4个FPS模式运行,产生单通估计而无需候选人得分,过滤,或集群. 附录A.7提供了更多的定性实例。

blocks.en: Candidate-to-decision and time-budget analysis. Table 2 examines the candidate behavior of GenPose++ as a strong generative baseline. Its candidate distribution is heavy-tailed: although the median rotation error is only 8 ∘ 8^{\circ} , the mean rises to 39 ∘ 39^{\circ} , with 26.9% of sampled candidates exceeding 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} . With K = 50 K=50 samples, an oracle selects a candidate within 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} for 79.3% of instances, achieving a median error of 1.78 ∘ 1.78^{\circ} . However, a deployed pipeline must still score, filter, cluster, or aggregate these candidates, so its final prediction can be substantially worse than the oracle. This highlights the candidate-to-decision gap discussed in the introduction: candidate-set quality and deployed prediction quality are related but not equivalent. Candidate quality also varies with object structure; no-symmetry objects have the largest mean rotation error, suggesting that sampling difficulty is driven not only by pose ambiguity but also by distinctive yet partially observed geometry. Additional candidate diagnostics by symmetry are provided in Appendix A.4 .

Geometry output and shape completion. Table 4 evaluates camera-frame geometry output.
The point-completion baselines are trained on the SOPE training split with the same partial-to-complete camera-frame targets.
Compared with these geometry-only baselines [ 47 , 48 , 49 ] , F2G-Pose achieves substantially lower Chamfer-L1 error on both SOPE and HouseCat6D. The qualitative results in Fig. 2 show that F2G-Pose successfully reconstructs complete object geometries.
Unlike these geometry-only completion baselines, F2G-Pose predicts shape from a shared RGB-D representation: depth points anchor the visible metric surface, and lifted RGB foundation features provide category, texture, and part cues for completing occluded regions.
Since the completed geometry is predicted directly in the camera frame, it can also be consumed by simple downstream planning modules without an additional canonical-to-camera alignment step. Because the inputs and supervision differ across systems and camera-frame CD also reflects global alignment, Appendix B.1 provides an additional matched RGB-D canonical-frame comparison.

Component ablation. Table 4 isolates the main design factors of F2G-Pose on ROPE.
Removing RGB foundation features leads to the largest performance drop, particularly on the rotation-sensitive VUS metrics, showing that point-wise visual lifting provides pose-relevant appearance and semantic cues beyond partial geometry alone.
Replacing the MoE Transformer with a parameter-equivalent dense FFN also reduces accuracy, suggesting that conditional capacity helps model category-level object diversity.
Removing auxiliary shape supervision further degrades pose-size prediction, indicating that dense camera-frame geometry supervision regularizes the shared RGB-D representation and directly benefits the final pose-size estimate.

blocks.en:
Representation analysis. Table 6 studies how different RGB-D representations affect direct pose-size prediction.
All variants are trained with the same pose-size losses, while varying the feature aggregation strategy, contextual encoder, foundation backbone, and the use of auxiliary shape supervision.
Replacing global feature pooling with DGCNN tokens improves both IoU and rotation-sensitive VUS, showing that local surface neighborhoods provide important geometric cues for direct pose estimation.
Adding Transformer context further improves performance by integrating local RGB-D evidence into an object-level representation.
The full model achieves the best results, indicating that local geometric tokenization, object-level context, and camera-frame geometry supervision are complementary.
Finally, replacing RADIO with DINOv2 or CLIP causes only modest degradation in IoU50, suggesting that the improvement is driven primarily by the architecture and supervision rather than by a specific foundation backbone.
Additional backbone, routing, and shape-decoder ablations are summarized in Appendix A.6 .

MoE routing analysis. Table 6 shows that top-2 MoE provides a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off.
Top-1 routing is faster but less accurate, while top-4 brings only marginal accuracy gains at a higher latency cost.
Compared with top-2 routing without balancing, the load-balanced top-2 MoE achieves higher routing entropy, lower load concentration, and better pose accuracy.
These results suggest that balanced conditional capacity improves the shared RGB-D representation while keeping inference cost moderate. Further instance-level analysis finds overlapping category-related expert preferences (Appendix B.3 ).

blocks.en:
Robustness under challenging materials. Table 7 reports performance on transparent and reflective objects, which often corrupt depth observations.
Compared with the overall ROPE performance, F2G-Pose shows moderate degradation on these material subsets, with reflective objects being more difficult than transparent ones, especially in VUS and Chamfer distance.
The performance drop is most apparent in IoU75, where depth holes, specular artifacts, and missing thin structures can perturb the estimated object extent.
A similar trend is observed on HouseCat6D, where reconstruction remains accurate for many transparent objects because their shapes are regular despite noisy depth.
Overall, F2G-Pose remains reasonably robust under material-induced sensing noise, while precise box alignment is still sensitive to imperfect depth observations.
Controlled RGB and depth perturbation results are reported in Appendix A.3 , with additional material examples in Fig. 9 . SAM-mask and controlled erosion/dilation results are provided in Appendix B.2 .

Table 8 evaluates cross-dataset transfer on real-world manipulable objects captured under different setups. The zero-/one-reference baseline protocols are detailed in Appendix B.5 .
On HANDAL, F2G-Pose outperforms the reference-free methods Any6D and GenPose++, while on ROPE it further surpasses the single-reference method FoundationPose and the reference-free method Any6D, without requiring an instance reference.
These results complement the controlled SOPE/ROPE benchmark by exposing the model to additional real objects, masks, backgrounds, and sensor noise patterns.
Despite these transfer gains, the low IoU75 values show that high-precision box alignment remains challenging under cross-dataset sensing and annotation differences.
These results provide additional evidence of F2G-Pose’s robustness under real-world distribution shifts, complementing the controlled category-level analysis on SOPE/ROPE; qualitative HANDAL examples are shown in Fig. 10 .

Robot manipulation. We validate the final pose-size decision in a real pick-and-place setup using an ARX robotic arm, a parallel-jaw gripper, and an external RealSense RGB-D camera.
All methods receive the same object masks and RGB-D crops, and the evaluated objects include bottles, bowls, cans, mugs, cups, hammers, pans, and wrench-like tools.
The predicted pose and metric size determine the grasp approach and placement target; the completed camera-frame shape is used only for collision checking.
Each trial randomizes object placement within a tabletop start region, and success requires grasping, transporting, and placing the object at the target without dropping or collision. The full model achieves 74/80 successful picks and 68/80 successful placements.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present F2G-Pose, a direct RGB-D framework that estimates category-level 6D pose, metric size, and camera-frame shape from a single observation.
By lifting dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds and encoding local-global geometry with a MoE Transformer, F2G-Pose predicts the deployed pose-size state in one feed-forward pass.
Experiments on SOPE, ROPE, HouseCat6D, HANDAL, and ARX manipulation show a favorable balance of accuracy, inference latency, and manipulation success, while the shape branch provides dense geometric supervision and approximate planning geometry.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了F2G-Pose,一个直接的RGB-D框架,从单一的观测中估算出类别级为6D的外观,度量大小和相机-帧形状.
F2G-Pose通过将稠密的视觉地基特征提升到部分点云并用MoE变形器编码出局部-全球几何,预测部署的姿势大小状态在一个向后传输的通道中.
关于SOPE,ROPE,HouseCat6D,HANDAL,和ARX操纵的实验显示在准确度,推论延迟度,和操纵成功度方面有有利的平衡,而外形分支则提供密集的几何监督并大致规划几何.

blocks.en:
Limitations. F2G-Pose assumes a segmented RGB-D crop at inference time, so mask failures and severe depth corruption can propagate to pose, size, and shape.
The method remains sensitive to thin or asymmetric parts, severe occlusion, and symmetric low-texture objects that admit multiple plausible rotations.
High-precision metric alignment remains weak under cross-dataset domain shift, which may require downstream refinement for tasks with tight geometric tolerances. Symmetry-aware supervision does not eliminate ambiguity under severe occlusion or near-symmetry, and the model provides no calibrated uncertainty or abstention mechanism.
Future work will address mask-free operation, broader real-object coverage, articulated or deformable categories, and active perception for heavy occlusion.
blocks.zh:
限制。 F2G-Pose在推论时假设一个分块的RGB-D收成,因此面具失败和严重深度腐败可以传播到外形,大小和形状.
这种方法仍然对薄或不对称的部分敏感,有严重的隐蔽性,有对称的低纹物体,这些物体能接受多种可能旋转.
在跨数据集域转移下,高精度度的度量比对仍然很弱,可能需要下游改进,以完成几何能耐性很强的任务。 对称感知监督并不能消除在严重隐蔽或接近对称情况下的模糊性,而该模型没有提供校正的不确定性或弃权机制.
今后的工作将涉及无遮罩操作、更广泛的实际目标覆盖、明确或可变形的类别,以及对重聚的主动感知。

blocks.en: Broader Impact. F2G-Pose advances category-level object perception for robotics and augmented reality. While improved pose estimation can benefit assistive manipulation and human–robot collaboration, it could also be applied in surveillance or autonomous systems without adequate safety oversight. We encourage responsible deployment with appropriate human supervision.
blocks.zh: 更宽的影响。 F2G-Pose推进了机器人的类别级对象感知和增强现实. 虽然改进的姿势估计可以有利于辅助操纵和人与机器人的合作,但也可以在没有充分安全监督的情况下用于监视或自动系统。 我们鼓励在适当的人监督下进行负责任的部署。

blocks.en: A.1 Model Details

blocks.en: F2G-Pose receives a segmented RGB crop and its corresponding partial point cloud. We sample 1024 points from the segmented depth observation and concatenate each point coordinate with a lifted visual feature. Frozen RADIOv2.5-L [ 13 ] provides feature maps from layers 8, 16, and 23. Independent 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional blocks compress each map from 1024 to 512 channels. Learned softmax-normalized layer weights combine them by summation, followed by a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutional block producing 1024 channels; both convolutional stages use BatchNorm and ReLU. We gather each point’s feature by integer-dividing its crop-pixel coordinates by the patch size of 16. This produces an input tensor of size B × 1024 × 1027 B\times 1024\times 1027 .
blocks.zh: F2G-Pose接收了分块的RGB作物及其相应的部分点云. 我们从分层深度观测中抽取出1024个点,并将每个点的坐标同提升的视觉特征相配合. 被冻的RADIOv2.5-L[13]提供了从第8,16和23层的地物图. 独立1×1 1\times 1 演化块压缩从1024到512道的每个地图. 所学的软马克斯-常态地层分量通过相加来结合它们,再取出一个3×3 3\times 3的相加分量块来生产出1024个通道;两个相加分相都使用BatchNorm和ReLU. 我们收集每个点的特征 通过整数分化它的收成像素坐标 通过补丁大小16。 这会产生一个大小为 B × 1024 × 1027 B\times 1024\times 1027的输入收音机.

blocks.en: The fused RGB-D point set is tokenized by a DGCNN encoder with two downsampling stages, reducing 1024 input points to 128 object tokens. The tokens are projected to 512 dimensions and processed by 8 Transformer blocks with 8 attention heads. In the full model, each Transformer feed-forward layer is replaced by a top-2 Mixture-of-Experts layer with 8 experts and the load-balancing loss described in the main paper. A learned softmax-weighted sum combines the block outputs; an MLP projects the tokens to 1024 dimensions before max pooling. The pose-size branch directly regresses rotation, translation, and metric size. The shape branch predicts 512 initial points, concatenates 256 farthest-point-sampled observed points, scores the 768 candidates and retains 512, then predicts four local offsets per retained point for a 2048-point completed shape. The selected 512 points and final 2048 points receive reconstruction supervision. Continuous rotational symmetries use 1 ∘ 1^{\circ} candidate sampling; objects with at least two continuously symmetric axes are excluded from the rotation loss.

blocks.en: F2G-Pose is trained only on the SOPE training split used in the main experiments. We train for 100 epochs with batch size 512 using AdamW. The initial learning rate is 10 − 4 10^{-4} , the weight decay is 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , and a LambdaLR schedule decays the learning rate by a factor of 0.9 every 8 epochs with a lower bound of 2% of the initial value. Training experiments are run with PyTorch 2.4 and CUDA 12.4 using automatic mixed precision, DistributedDataParallel, and synchronized BatchNorm on 4 NVIDIA H200 GPUs.

blocks.en: The qualitative failure cases are drawn from ROPE and are consistent with the limitations stated in the paper: corrupted depth on thin or reflective structures, heavy occlusion, and ambiguous rotations for symmetric or weakly textured objects.
blocks.zh: 质的故障案例取自ROPE,符合论文所陈述的局限性:薄或反射结构上腐蚀了深度,被大量隐蔽,对称或纹理薄弱物体的旋转模棱两可.

blocks.en: Reflective or transparent surfaces often produce missing or distorted depth. RADIO features provide complementary appearance cues, but they cannot fully recover metric extent when the observed point cloud loses thin handles, sharp edges, or asymmetric parts. This leads to high-precision IoU and rotation errors, as shown in Fig. 6 .
blocks.zh: 反射或透明地表往往产生缺失或扭曲的深度。 RADIO特征提供了互补的外观提示,但当观测到的点云失去细柄,尖端或不对称部分时,它们无法完全恢复度量. 如图6所示,这导致了高精度IoU和旋转错误。

blocks.en: Under mild or moderate occlusion, the model can often infer pose from visible geometry and lifted semantic cues. Severe occlusion removes too much task-relevant evidence, especially when the hidden region contains the asymmetric part needed to disambiguate orientation.
blocks.zh: 在轻度或中度隐蔽下,模型往往可以推断出从可见的几何学和被解除的语义提示来摆出姿势. 严重封杀消除了太多与任务相关的证据,特别是当隐蔽区域包含分散取向所需的不对称部分时.

blocks.en: Beyond load balance, we analyze instance-level routing over 7,466 object samples. Routing exhibits an association with category (Cramér’s V = 0.306 V=0.306 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Different experts show preferences for broad geometry-related groups, including bag-like, flat, and bowl-like objects, with substantial overlap. This suggests distributed specialization rather than a rigid one-expert-per-category partition. Associations with material and visibility are weaker, and no significant independent association with symmetry was found. These observations complement the capacity and balance analysis in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 除了负载平衡之外,我们分析7 466个物体样本的例级径向。 运行显示与类别有关的关联(Cramér的V=0.306 V=0.306,p < 0.001 p < 0.001 ) 。 不同的专家对与几何学有关的广度群体表示偏好,包括袋状、平相和碗状物体,它们之间有相当的重叠。 这表明有分布的专业化,而不是僵化的每类专家分工。 具有材料和能见度的社团较弱,没有发现与对称性相关的重大独立社团. 这些意见补充了表6中的能力和平衡分析。

blocks.en: B.4 HANDAL Selection and Per-Category Results
blocks.zh: B.4 选取和按类别分列的结果

blocks.en: HANDAL is an independent real-world dataset with sensing conditions, capture environments, and object instances distinct from SOPE. Among its 17 categories, we evaluate the seven with direct semantic correspondences to the SOPE taxonomy. Selection is based on taxonomy correspondence, not model performance. The remaining categories have ambiguous mappings or no direct SOPE counterparts and are excluded because no corresponding canonical frame is defined. These seven categories map to six SOPE categories, with both wrench types mapped to spanner .
blocks.zh: HANDAL是一个独立的现实世界数据集,具有感知条件,捕捉环境,以及不同于SOPE的物体实例. 在其17个类别中,我们用SOPE分类学的直接语义通信来评价这7个类别. 选择是基于分类学的对应,而不是模型性能. 其余的类别有模棱两可的映射或没有直接的SOPE对应,由于没有定义相应的犬目框架被排除在外. 这7个类别映射到6个SOPE类别,两个扳手类型都被映射到扳手上。

blocks.en: Table 17: HANDAL per-category IoU AUC for the seven directly matched categories. Counts refer to instances. The last row is the unweighted macro-average over seven HANDAL categories.
blocks.zh: 表17:7个直接对应的类别按IoU AUC分类的ANDAL。 计数是指例. 最后一行是未经加权的宏平均值超过七个汉大类.

blocks.en: The evaluation covers 92 instances. The macro-average AUCs are 35.0, 11.7, and 0.3 at IoU25, IoU50, and IoU75. These results indicate coarse 3D alignment under cross-dataset transfer, while precise joint estimation of pose, size, and extent remains challenging. Both ROPE and this HANDAL subset evaluate seen-category, unseen-instance transfer, rather than unseen-category generalization.
blocks.zh: 评价涉及92个实例。 宏观平均AUC为35.0分,11.7分,IoU25分,IoU50分和IoU75分,0.3分. 这些结果表明,在跨数据集转移下,三维协调很粗糙,而对姿势、规模和程度的精确联合估计仍然具有挑战性。 ROPE和HANDAL子集都评价了外观类,隐形转移,而不是隐形类通论.

blocks.en: B.5 Reference-Free and Single-Reference Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: B.5 无参考和单一参考评价议定书

blocks.en: “Zero reference” means that no additional reference view is supplied beyond the test RGB-D observation. We use the official repository’s reference-free image-to-3D pathway, which reconstructs a coarse shape from the test observation and subsequently estimates pose using that reconstructed shape.
blocks.zh: “零参考”是指除了测试RGB-D观测之外,不提供额外的参考视图。 我们使用官方寄存器的无参考图像到3D路径,这些路径从测试观察中重建出粗糙的形状,然后用被重建的形状进行估计。

blocks.en: We randomly sample one additional view of the same object from its ROPE multi-view sequence as the reference image and apply the standard reference-query inference protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们从它的ROPE多视图序列中随机抽取了同一个对象的额外视图,作为参考图像,并应用了标准参考-query推断协议.

blocks.en: We evaluate the model-free pathway under the same one-reference constraint. One additional real view of the same object is randomly sampled from its ROPE sequence; an object mesh is reconstructed from that view and used for pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价无模型路径 在同一单一参考限制。 同一物体的另一个真实视图是从它的ROPE序列中随机取出;一个物体网由该视图重建出并用于平面估计.
